notes: Watershed names follow the user; archived Soap boundary filename is soaprootcreek_boundary.geojson.
Source boundaries use projected EPSG:32611 coordinates and are explicitly transformed to WGS84.
Only Soap and Newt records included; Providence is a separate site.
Borehole coordinates and completion metadata are archival; no assertion of current instrument operation.
Completed depths and original drilled depths are separate. No shaft is inferred where completed depth is absent.
Burn outline omitted: its shapefile has no CRS or attributes identifying acquisition or fire.
NEON tower position and dimensions are from official location TOWER111206. The terrain elevation is not shifted to match source ground elevation.
Terrain elevations use NEON DTM directly with no offsets. Acquisition: 2026-04-06; 2026_SOAP_9 (provisional)

channels.method: D8 routing with pit/depression filling and flat resolution; 2 ha contributing-area threshold. Full available raster routed before display clipping; linework clipped 5 m inside the valid raster footprint.
channels.note: Terrain-derived potential drainage; not surveyed stream positions, channel widths, or current streamflow. Display elevations remain unchanged by routing fills. No flow is inferred across source nodata.

stream_gages.Newt: Approximate mapped outlet. User reports a gage; its GPS coordinate is not available.
